ex: We set a monthly budget for groceries and eating out.
exzh: 我們為買菜和外食訂了每月預算。

exzh: 我每個月把部分薪水存進儲蓄帳戶。

exzh: 我的房租從日常帳戶自動扣款。

ex: The bank raised the interest rate on home loans again.
exzh: 銀行又調高了房貸利率。

ex: They'll be paying off the mortgage for the next twenty years.

exzh: 遲繳帳單會傷害你的信用分數。

exzh: 這裡多數店家都能用金融卡付款。

exzh: 我忘了準時繳,被收了滯納金。

exzh: 銀行收了我三十元的透支費。

exzh: 你今晚可以轉帳到我帳戶嗎?

ex: International wire transfer fees can be surprisingly high.
exzh: 國際電匯手續費可能高得驚人。

exzh: 銀行的匯率比機場好。

ex: Keep the receipt in case you need to return it.
exzh: 留著收據,以防需要退貨。

ex: I asked for a refund because the headphones were broken.
exzh: 耳機壞了,所以我要求退款。

ex: I'm paying for the laptop in twelve monthly installments.
exzh: 我的筆電分十二期每月付款。

ex: I finally filed my tax return last night.
exzh: 我昨晚終於報完稅了。

ex: Medical expenses may count as a tax deduction.
exzh: 醫療支出可能可以列為扣除額。

exzh: 所得稅會直接從我的薪資扣掉。

exzh: 現在大多數人都線上報稅。

ex: The job offers a good salary and flexible hours.
exzh: 這份工作薪水不錯,時間也彈性。

ex: She asked her manager for a pay raise after the project.
exzh: 專案結束後她向主管要求加薪。

ex: We usually get a year-end bonus before Lunar New Year.
exzh: 我們通常在農曆年前拿到年終獎金。

ex: Living expenses in Taipei keep going up.
exzh: 台北的生活開銷一直在漲。

ex: Submit your receipts to HR for reimbursement.
exzh: 把收據交給人資報帳。

ex: The client hasn't paid our invoice yet.
exzh: 客戶還沒付我們的請款單。

ex: Utility bills are higher in summer because of the AC.
exzh: 夏天因為開冷氣,水電費比較高。

ex: Half my salary goes to rent.
exzh: 我一半的薪水都拿去付房租。

ex: I canceled my gym subscription because I never went.
exzh: 我從沒去過,所以取消了健身房訂閱。

ex: We can't afford a new car right now.
exzh: 我們現在買不起新車。

ex: I'm on a tight budget this month, so let's cook at home.
exzh: 我這個月手頭很緊,在家煮吧。

ex: Many young people work two jobs just to make ends meet.
exzh: 很多年輕人兼兩份工才勉強打平。

en: cost an arm and a leg
ex: That phone must cost an arm and a leg.
exzh: 那支手機一定貴得要命。

ex: Twenty bucks for a coffee? What a rip-off!
exzh: 一杯咖啡二十塊?太坑了吧!

ex: This jacket was a real bargain at half price.
exzh: 這件外套半價,真的很划算。

ex: Students get a ten percent discount here.
exzh: 學生在這裡打九折。

ex: This card gives two percent cash back on online purchases.
exzh: 這張卡網購有百分之二現金回饋。

ex: I check my bank statement every month for strange charges.
exzh: 我每月看對帳單有沒有奇怪的扣款。

ex: The card has no annual fee for the first year.
exzh: 這張卡首年免年費。

ex: Inflation has made everyday groceries noticeably more expensive.
exzh: 通膨讓日常食品明顯變貴。

exzh: 經濟衰退期間很多公司凍結招聘。

ex: The stock market dropped sharply on Monday morning.
exzh: 股市週一早上大跌。

ex: He owns a few shares in a chip company.
exzh: 他持有一家晶片公司的一些股份。

ex: The company pays a dividend twice a year.
exzh: 這家公司一年配兩次股利。

ex: Everyone feels like a genius in a bull market.
exzh: 牛市裡人人都覺得自己是天才。

ex: Prices kept falling for months during the bear market.
exzh: 熊市期間價格連跌好幾個月。

ex: Crypto prices are extremely volatile.
exzh: 加密貨幣價格波動極大。

ex: She reviews her portfolio once every quarter.
exzh: 她每季檢視一次投資組合。

ex: An index fund tracks the whole market instead of single stocks.
exzh: 指數型基金追蹤整體市場,而非個股。

ex: Government bonds are usually seen as low risk.
exzh: 政府公債通常被視為低風險。

ex: Some shops now accept cryptocurrency as payment.
exzh: 有些店家現在接受加密貨幣付款。

ex: Your net worth is what you own minus what you owe.
exzh: 淨資產就是資產減掉負債。

ex: He worked hard to get out of debt.
exzh: 他努力工作還清債務。

ex: I finally managed to pay off my student loan.
exzh: 我終於還清了學貸。

ex: I still owe you for the movie tickets.
exzh: 我還欠你電影票的錢。

ex: Let's split the bill — it's easier.
exzh: 我們分攤帳單吧,比較簡單。

ex: Put your wallet away, it's on me tonight.
exzh: 錢包收起來,今晚我請。

ex: Here's twenty dollars — keep the change.
exzh: 這是二十塊,不用找了。

ex: In the US, people usually leave a tip of fifteen to twenty percent.
exzh: 在美國,一般留百分之十五到二十的小費。

ex: Which currency should I bring to Japan?
exzh: 去日本該帶哪種貨幣?

ex: There's a ten percent service fee added to the bill.
exzh: 帳單另加百分之十服務費。

ex: Try to keep six months of expenses in an emergency fund.
exzh: 試著存半年開銷當緊急預備金。

ex: It's never too early to start saving for retirement.
exzh: 為退休存錢永遠不嫌早。

ex: My parents live on their pension now.
exzh: 我爸媽現在靠退休金生活。

ex: My insurance premium went up after the accident.
exzh: 出車禍後我的保費漲了。

ex: Our fiscal year ends in June, not December.
exzh: 我們的會計年度在六月結束,不是十二月。

ex: The shop finally made a profit in its second year.
exzh: 那家店第二年終於有獲利。

ex: Revenue grew, but costs grew even faster.
exzh: 營收成長了,但成本漲得更快。

ex: Small businesses often fail because of cash flow problems.
exzh: 小公司常因現金流問題倒閉。

ex: The renovation is starting to go over budget.
exzh: 裝修開始超出預算了。

ex: I'm trying to save up for a trip to Iceland.
exzh: 我正在存錢去冰島旅行。

ex: Do you want to pay in cash or by card?
exzh: 你要付現還是刷卡?

ex: I loved the sofa until I saw the price tag.
exzh: 看到標價之前我很喜歡那張沙發。

ex: Read the contract carefully to avoid hidden fees.
exzh: 仔細讀合約,避免隱藏費用。

ex: Oh, my bad — I thought you were done.
exzh: 喔,抱歉,我以為你用完了。

ex: I'm gonna grab a coffee, want one?
exzh: 我要去買咖啡,你要嗎?

ex: Do you wanna watch a movie tonight?
exzh: 你今晚想看電影嗎?

ex: Sorry, I gotta go — my bus is here.
exzh: 抱歉,我得走了,公車來了。

ex: I'm kinda tired, let's head home.
exzh: 我有點累,回家吧。

ex: Where's Mike? — Dunno, he left early.
exzh: Mike 呢?——不知道,他早走了。

ex: Lemme check and get back to you.
exzh: 讓我查一下再回你。

ex: Sorry I'm late! — No worries, we just started.
exzh: 抱歉遲到!——沒事,我們才剛開始。

ex: We should hang out more often.
exzh: 我們應該多出來聚聚。

ex: My new boss is pretty chill about working from home.
exzh: 新主管對在家工作蠻隨和的。

ex: I only went to the party because of FOMO.
exzh: 我去那個派對只是因為怕錯過。

ex: I lowkey want to quit and travel for a year.
exzh: 我其實有點想辭職去旅行一年。

ex: I'm highkey excited about this weekend.
exzh: 我超期待這週末的。

ex: This is the best ramen in town, no cap.
exzh: 這是全城最好吃的拉麵,不騙你。

ex: You finished it in one day? That's cap.
exzh: 你一天就做完?騙人吧。

ex: I love the vibe of this café.
exzh: 我很喜歡這間咖啡店的氛圍。

exzh: 這網站是正規的還是詐騙?

exzh: 他看似不錯,後來卻開始搞消失。

ex: You cook, I'll wash the dishes. — It's a deal.
exzh: 你煮飯,我洗碗。——一言為定。

exzh: 晚餐後去唱歌?——我可以。

exzh: 你們週六去爬山?我也要。

exzh: 來台北時找我。

ex: Gotta run, catch you later!
exzh: 得走了,回頭見!

exzh: 嘿,最近怎樣?——沒什麼,你呢?

ex: I missed the train, but it's no big deal.
exzh: 我錯過火車,但沒什麼大不了。

exzh: 你拿到那份工作?真的假的?

ex: The concert got canceled? What a bummer.
exzh: 演唱會取消了?真掃興。

exzh: 你錢包掉了?天啊,真慘。

exzh: 他還在為輸球不爽。

exzh: 那封要我密碼的信看起來很可疑。

exzh: 等我一下,有人敲門。

exzh: 說實話,那場簡報真的很厲害。

exzh: 我不知道幾點開會,問 Amy。

exzh: 把地址私訊給我就好。

exzh: 他貼新車只是為了炫耀。

exzh: 看自己以前的影片超尷尬。

exzh: 做成城堡的蛋糕?你也太誇張。

exzh: 你去約會了?快說說!

exzh: 七點見?——好啊。

exzh: 熬夜後喝的咖啡感覺特別不一樣。

exzh: 你整天在網上,出去走走吧。

exzh: 大家都在吹那部電影,但其實很普。

exzh: 上週末我把整季一口氣追完了。

zh: 沙發馬鈴薯、宅在家的人

exzh: 別當沙發馬鈴薯,跟我去慢跑。

exzh: 為了寫完報告我熬了通宵。

exzh: 我今晚可以借住你家嗎?

exzh: 只花了我五塊錢。

exzh: 那台腳踏車他花了兩千塊。

ex: The test was a piece of cake.
exzh: 那個考試簡單得很。

exzh: 我知道最近工作很瘋,撐住啊。

exzh: 先別抓狂,我刮到你的車了。

exzh: 快去吃飯吧,我餓到要發脾氣了。

exzh: 誰能修一下印表機?——我來!

exzh: 謝謝幫我代班,你最棒了!

exzh: 面試如何?——我覺得我表現超好。

exzh: 山頂的景色超棒。

ex: I totally forgot about the meeting.
exzh: 我完全忘了那個會。

ex: Chill out, we still have plenty of time.
exzh: 放輕鬆,我們時間還很多。

exzh: 免費手機?有什麼陷阱?

ex: It's just hard to explain, ya know?
exzh: 就是很難解釋,你懂吧?

exzh: 那次考試我搞砸得很嚴重。

exzh: 他雖然有錢,但很平易近人。

exzh: 我超級挺這個樂團。

exzh: 週一早上沒咖啡,真的好痛苦。

ex: I'm so ready for the holidays. — Same here.
exzh: 我超想放假。——我也是。

exzh: 長話短說,我們錯過了班機。

exzh: 大型簡報前我總是很焦慮。

ex: I got frustrated when the code kept failing.
exzh: 程式一直出錯讓我很挫折。

ex: She felt overwhelmed by all the deadlines.
exzh: 一堆截止日讓她喘不過氣。

exzh: 檢查結果正常時我大大鬆一口氣。

exzh: 我把老師叫成媽媽時好尷尬。

exzh: 她跟別的男生說話他就吃醋。

exzh: 剛到國外生活可能會覺得寂寞。

exzh: 在加拿大的第一個冬天我很想家。

ex: We're thrilled to have you on the team.
exzh: 很高興你加入團隊。

ex: I was disappointed that the trip got canceled.
exzh: 旅行被取消讓我很失望。

ex: She was upset that nobody remembered her birthday.
exzh: 沒人記得她生日讓她很難過。

ex: I'm annoyed that the bus is late again.
exzh: 公車又遲到,真煩。

ex: The customer was furious about the double charge.
exzh: 客人對重複扣款非常憤怒。

ex: After the twelve-hour flight, I was exhausted.
exzh: 飛了十二小時後我累壞了。

exzh: 加班好幾個月後他徹底倦怠了。

ex: I'm so stressed out about the move.
exzh: 搬家讓我壓力好大。

exzh: 她滿足於鄉間的簡單生活。

exzh: 練習讓我說英文更有自信。

exzh: 他對自己的口音沒自信。

exzh: 我姊姊很外向,容易交朋友。

ex: I'm a bit introverted, so big parties drain me.

ex: Our new roommate is really easygoing.

exzh: 我爸固執到不肯問路。

exzh: 你幫我留位子真體貼。

ex: What a thoughtful gift — thank you!
exzh: 好貼心的禮物,謝謝!

exzh: 她很願意花時間,總幫新人。

ex: He's the most reliable person on our team.
exzh: 他是我們團隊最可靠的人。

exzh: 他有才華但有點傲慢。

ex: Despite her success, she stayed humble.
exzh: 雖然成功,她依然謙虛。

ex: He gets moody when he doesn't sleep enough.
exzh: 他睡不夠就會情緒化。

exzh: 說話溫和點,她對體重很敏感。

exzh: 朋友洩漏她的秘密,她覺得被背叛。

exzh: 我不想為了錢跟他鬧翻。

exzh: 交往五年後他們決定分手。

ex: Cheer up, it's not the end of the world.
exzh: 打起精神,又不是世界末日。

ex: Take a deep breath and try to calm down.
exzh: 深呼吸,試著冷靜下來。
note: 直接對生氣的人說會火上加油

ex: Let's keep in touch after you move.
exzh: 你搬家後我們保持聯絡。

ex: It's easy to lose touch after you move away.
exzh: 搬走後很容易失去聯絡。

ex: His constant humming starts to get on my nerves.
exzh: 他一直哼歌開始讓我很煩。

ex: It took him months to open up about his past.
exzh: 他花了好幾個月才談起他的過去。

ex: I have mixed feelings about leaving my old job.
exzh: 離開舊工作我心情五味雜陳。

ex: She's been on cloud nine since the engagement.
exzh: 訂婚後她一直樂翻天。

ex: I tend to feel down when it rains for days.
exzh: 連下好幾天雨我就容易心情低落。

ex: I had butterflies in my stomach before the interview.
exzh: 面試前我緊張得七上八下。

ex: Her warm smile put everyone at ease.
exzh: 她溫暖的笑容讓大家都很自在。

ex: It's just feedback, don't take it personally.
exzh: 這只是回饋,別往心裡去。

ex: Life's too short to hold a grudge.
exzh: 人生苦短,別記仇。

ex: Lack of sleep gives me terrible mood swings.
exzh: 睡眠不足讓我情緒起伏很大。

ex: Teenagers often drink because of peer pressure.
exzh: 青少年常因同儕壓力而喝酒。

ex: It's healthy to set boundaries with your boss.
exzh: 跟老闆設立界線是健康的。

ex: Moving abroad pushed me out of my comfort zone.
exzh: 出國生活把我推出舒適圈。

ex: My biggest pet peeve is people chewing loudly.
exzh: 我最受不了別人吃東西大聲。

ex: I heard about your grandfather. I'm sorry for your loss.
exzh: 聽說你爺爺的事了,請節哀。

en: I didn't mean to upset you.
ex: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to upset you.
exzh: 對不起,我不是故意讓你難過的。

ex: Dinner was lovely. Thanks for having me.
exzh: 晚餐很棒,謝謝招待。

ex: Get some rest and take care.
exzh: 好好休息,保重。

ex: I missed your call earlier. Please accept my apologies.
exzh: 我稍早漏接你電話,請見諒。

ex: Congratulations on your promotion! You totally deserve it.
exzh: 恭喜升遷!這是你應得的。

en: I'm here if you need to talk.
ex: No pressure, but I'm here if you need to talk.
exzh: 不勉強,但想聊隨時找我。

ex: You're caring for your mom alone? That must be hard.
exzh: 你一個人照顧媽媽?那一定很辛苦。

ex: Thanks for the compliment — that made my day.
exzh: 謝謝讚美,讓我一整天心情都好。

ex: Your message really made my day.
exzh: 你的訊息讓我開心了一整天。

ex: There was an awkward silence after his joke.
exzh: 他講完笑話後一陣尷尬的沉默。

ex: This song makes me nostalgic for college.
exzh: 這首歌讓我懷念大學時光。

ex: My wife has been really supportive of my career change.
exzh: 我太太很支持我轉職。

ex: You worked so hard for this. I'm proud of you.
exzh: 你為此這麼努力,我以你為榮。

ex: Sorry, it's a bit noisy. Could you say that again?
exzh: 抱歉,有點吵。可以再說一次嗎?

ex: Hey, I'm running a bit late. Be there in ten.
exzh: 嘿,我會晚點到,十分鐘後到。

ex: So we test it first, then deploy? — That makes sense.
exzh: 所以先測再部署?——有道理。

ex: Thanks for waiting. — No problem at all.
exzh: 謝謝你等我。——完全沒問題。

en: What do you mean by that?
ex: He said the plan is risky. What do you mean by that?
exzh: 他說這計畫有風險。你那是什麼意思?

ex: Hey Tom, how's it going? — Pretty good, thanks.
exzh: 嘿 Tom,最近好嗎?——不錯,謝謝。

ex: Wow, long time no see! How have you been?
exzh: 哇,好久不見!最近好嗎?

ex: Morning! How was your weekend?
exzh: 早!週末過得如何?

en: What do you do for a living?
ex: So, what do you do for a living? — I'm a software engineer.
exzh: 你做什麼工作?——我是軟體工程師。

en: It was nice talking to you.
ex: I have to go, but it was nice talking to you.
exzh: 我得走了,很高興跟你聊。

ex: Wow, it's late. I should get going.
exzh: 哇,好晚了,我該走了。

ex: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Which room?
exzh: 抱歉,我沒聽清楚。哪間會議室?

en: Could you speak a little slower?
ex: My English isn't great. Could you speak a little slower?
exzh: 我英文不太好,可以說慢一點嗎?

ex: It sounds interesting. Let me think about it.
exzh: 聽起來有意思,讓我想一想。

ex: Sorry, I'm not sure I follow. Can you give an example?
exzh: 抱歉,我不太懂。可以舉個例子嗎?

ex: Meet at the station at six? — Sounds good to me.
exzh: 六點車站見?——可以啊。

ex: I see what you mean. But the cost is still an issue.
exzh: 我懂你意思,但成本還是個問題。
note: 常接 but 提不同看法

en: I'm afraid I can't make it.
ex: Thanks for the invite, but I'm afraid I can't make it.
exzh: 謝謝邀請,但恐怕我去不了。

ex: Are you free on Friday? Let's grab dinner.
exzh: 你週五有空嗎?一起吃晚餐吧。

ex: I'm flexible tomorrow. What time works for you?
exzh: 我明天時間彈性,你幾點方便?

ex: Next Tuesday? Let me check my calendar.
exzh: 下週二?我查一下行事曆。

en: Can I get back to you on that?
ex: I need to ask my team. Can I get back to you on that?
exzh: 我得問團隊,晚點回覆你好嗎?

ex: I'm not sure yet, but I'll let you know.
exzh: 還不確定,我再跟你說。

ex: Hey, do you have a minute? I need your advice.
exzh: 嘿,你有空一下嗎?想問你意見。

ex: Sorry to bother you. Where's the restroom?
exzh: 抱歉打擾,請問洗手間在哪?

ex: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
exzh: 不好意思,這位子有人坐嗎?

en: Could you do me a favor?
ex: Could you do me a favor? — Sure, what is it?
exzh: 可以幫我個忙嗎?——好啊,什麼事?

ex: Thanks for staying late. I really appreciate it.
exzh: 謝謝你留晚一點,真的很感謝。

ex: Thanks for the ride. — Don't mention it.
exzh: 謝謝載我。——別客氣。

en: What have you been up to?
ex: Haven't seen you in ages! What have you been up to?
exzh: 好久沒見!你最近在忙什麼?

ex: What's new? — Not much, just working.
exzh: 最近怎樣?——沒什麼,就上班。

ex: It's been a while. How's your family?
exzh: 好一陣子沒見了,家人好嗎?

ex: You had your interview today, right? How did it go?
exzh: 你今天面試對吧?結果怎樣?

ex: I didn't get the job. — Oh, that's too bad.
exzh: 我沒上。——喔,真可惜。

ex: I finally ran a half marathon. — Good for you!
exzh: 我終於跑完半馬了。——太棒了!

ex: My mom is feeling better. — I'm glad to hear that.
exzh: 我媽好多了。——聽到真高興。

ex: They canceled the whole project? Are you serious?
exzh: 整個專案取消?你認真的嗎?

ex: You used to live in Japan? I had no idea.
exzh: 你以前住日本?我完全不知道。

ex: That's a good point. I hadn't thought of that.
exzh: 說得好,我沒想到這點。

ex: I'd rather stay in tonight. — Fair enough.
exzh: 我今晚想待在家。——也是啦。

ex: Everyone's here. So, what's the plan?
exzh: 大家都到了,那計畫是什麼?

ex: Where should we meet? The front gate?
exzh: 我們約哪裡?正門嗎?

ex: Don't worry, I'm on my way.
exzh: 別擔心,我在路上了。

ex: No rush on the report. Take your time.
exzh: 報告不急,慢慢來。

ex: Oh, never mind. I found my keys.
exzh: 喔,沒事了,我找到鑰匙了。

ex: Pizza or sushi? — It's up to you.
exzh: 披薩還是壽司?——你決定。

ex: Window or aisle? — I don't mind either way.
exzh: 靠窗還是走道?——我都可以。

ex: It's almost Friday. Any plans for the weekend?
exzh: 快週五了,週末有什麼計畫?

ex: Thanks for your help. Have a good one!
exzh: 謝謝幫忙,祝你今天愉快!

ex: I'm boarding now. Talk to you later.
exzh: 我要登機了,晚點聊。

ex: Great seeing you! Let's grab lunch sometime.
exzh: 很高興見到你!改天一起吃午餐吧。

ex: Mind if I join you? All the other tables are full.
exzh: 介意我一起坐嗎?其他桌都滿了。
note: 回答 Not at all=不介意

ex: Sorry, how do you pronounce this?
exzh: 抱歉,這個怎麼唸?

en: Can you give me a hand?
ex: This box is heavy. Can you give me a hand?
exzh: 這箱子好重,可以幫我一下嗎?

ex: Hold my bag, I'll be right back.
exzh: 幫我拿包包,我馬上回來。

ex: Hold on a second. I'm getting another call.
exzh: 等一下,我有另一通電話。

ex: Sorry I didn't reply — it slipped my mind.
exzh: 抱歉沒回你,我一時忘了。

ex: We need better documentation. — I couldn't agree more.
exzh: 我們需要更好的文件。——完全同意。

ex: It's almost nine. Let's call it a day.
exzh: 快九點了,今天就到這吧。

ex: I like the blue one. What do you think?
exzh: 我喜歡藍色那個,你覺得呢?

ex: Don't worry about the booking. I'll take care of it.
exzh: 訂位別擔心,我來處理。

ex: Hi, I'm Kevin. — Nice to meet you.
exzh: 嗨,我是 Kevin。——很高興認識你。

ex: By the way, did you see my email?
exzh: 順帶一提,你有看到我的信嗎?

ex: To be honest, I'm not a big fan of spicy food.
exzh: 老實說,我不太愛吃辣。

ex: Speaking of which, have you booked your flight?
exzh: 說到這個,你訂機票了嗎?

ex: As far as I know, the office is closed on Monday.
exzh: 據我所知,辦公室週一休息。

ex: If you ask me, the old design was cleaner.
exzh: 要我說,舊設計比較簡潔。

ex: In other words, we need more time.
exzh: 換句話說,我們需要更多時間。

ex: It's expensive. That being said, the quality is great.
exzh: 它很貴。話雖如此,品質很好。

ex: On second thought, I'll have tea instead.
exzh: 想想還是改喝茶好了。

ex: Just out of curiosity, how long did that take?
exzh: 純粹好奇,那花了多久?

ex: Bring an umbrella just in case.
exzh: 帶把傘以防萬一。

ex: Send it whenever you can, no rush.
exzh: 你方便時再寄,不急。

ex: Dinner at seven, then a movie? — Sounds like a plan.
exzh: 七點吃飯再看電影?——就這麼辦。

ex: You slept three hours? No wonder you're tired.
exzh: 你只睡三小時?難怪你這麼累。

ex: The results come out tomorrow — fingers crossed!
exzh: 結果明天公布,祈禱好運!

ex: Do you work weekends? — It depends on the project.
exzh: 你週末要上班嗎?——看專案而定。

ex: Come to think of it, I haven't seen him all week.
exzh: 這麼說來,我整週都沒看到他。

en: off the top of my head
ex: Off the top of my head, I'd say about fifty people.
exzh: 我直覺估計大概五十人。

ex: Are you coming? — I guess, if I finish work early.
exzh: 你會來嗎?——應該吧,如果早下班。
